plain_english: Finding You inside the world, they get inside You — never far are Your devotees.
sanskrit_cite: jagato 'ntarato bhavantam āptvā punar etad bhavato 'ntarāl labhante jagadīśa tavaiva bhaktibhājo na hi teṣām iha dūrato 'sti kiñcit

plain_english: He here, She everywhere, pregnant with the order of all things, supreme — but at the ultimate step, no division of Her nor of the triple world.
sanskrit_cite: kvacid eva bhavān kvacid bhavānī sakalārthakramagarbhiṇī pradhānā paramārthapade tu naiva devyā bhavato nāpi jatattrayasya bhedaḥ

plain_english: The ungrateful know not the auspicious, though proud; all things, though effort-favored — but this mind, though risen, does not perceive the self-form here; ah, alas, I am destroyed.
sanskrit_cite: no jānate subhagam apy avalepavanto lokāḥ prayatnasubhagā nikhila hi bhāvāḥ cetaḥ punar yad idam udyatam apy avaiti naivātmarūpam iha hā tad aho hato 'smi

plain_english: Who has gained dwelling in the self made of You, Your feet worshipped with full wealth — needing neither food nor covering ever: to him I bow.
sanskrit_cite: bhavanmayasvātmanivāsalabdhasampadbharābhyarcitayuṣmadaṅghriḥ na bhojanācchādanam apy ajasram apekṣate yas tam ahaṃ nato 'smi

plain_english: Ever dwelling in Your body-abode yet inwardly supreme-burning, this world — by Your will make me here, of worship-joy-nature.
sanskrit_cite: sadā bhavaddehanivāsasvastho 'py antaḥ paraṃ dahyata eṣa lokaḥ tavecchayā tat kuru me yathātra tvadarcanānandamayo bhaveyam

plain_english: Spontaneously risen, touching Your lotus-feet pair, drinking the worship-nectar — mind intent, may I be, in gathering my aims, with mere touch-happiness as world-tour.
sanskrit_cite: svarasoditayuṣmadaṅghripadmadvayapūjāmṛtapānasaktacittaḥ sakārthacayeṣv ahaṃ bhaveyam sukhasaṃsparśanamātralokayātraḥ

plain_english: In the whole field of dealings, plainly, while You throb inside, Lord — coming and going ever, may my things shine always.
sanskrit_cite: sakalavyavahāragocare sphuṭam antaḥ spurati tvayi prabho upayānty apayānti cāniśam mama vastūni vibhāntu sarvadā

plain_english: Ever in Your city, or parted and roaming — may I be, by You: never even a moment's defeat for me, where I am become of You.
sanskrit_cite: satatam eva tavaiva pure 'thavāpy arahito vicareyam ahaṃ tvayā kṣaṇalavo 'py atha mā sma bhavet sa me na vijaye nanu yatra bhavanmayaḥ

plain_english: Filled all round with cool nectar-floods streaming from Your limbs — in the wealth of worshipping You here, Your devotees move in saṃsāra's middle.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgaparisravatsuśītāmṛtapūrair bharite samantato 'pi bhavadarcanasampadeha bhaktās tava saṃsārasaro 'ntare caranti

plain_english: In the cool shade of the great-mantra tree, in Your great forest, in my own self always, Lord, may I dwell as Your worshipper.
sanskrit_cite: mahāmantratarucchāyāśītale tvanmahāvane nijātmani sadā nātha vaseyaṃ tava pūjakaḥ

plain_english: As everything living mirrors You, mirror-formed — so before me, Lord, come forth graced with three eyes and trident.
sanskrit_cite: prativastu samastajīvataḥ pratibhāsi pratibhāmayo yathā mama nātha tathā puraḥ prathāṃ vraja netratrayaśūlaśobhitaḥ

plain_english: From pride-offering, love-held devotion-built — pleased, when will You be everywhere my eyes' ground?
sanskrit_cite: abhimānacarūpahārato mamatābhaktibhareṇa kalpitāt paritoṣagataḥ kadā bhavān mama sarvatra bhaved dṛśaḥ padam

plain_english: Dwelling in the nectar-ocean middle, mind drowned in Your worship-rite alone — may I do all people's business, tasting everything everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: nivasanparamāmṛtābdhimadhye bhavadarcāvidhimātramagnacittaḥ sakalaṃ janavṛttam ācareyaṃ rasayan sarvata eva kiñcanāpi

plain_english: Your thing here, Your truth — who is fit to disclose the matter? This same name-form-sport-unequalled of Yours takes away — since You are Hara, the Taker.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadīyam ihāstu vastu tattvaṃ vivarītuṃ ka ivātra pātram arthe idam eva hi nāmarūpaceṣṭādyasamaṃ te harate haro 'si yasmāt

plain_english: For peace, no hankering for pleasure at all, among those drunk with devotion amassed — nor even begging the fruit of seeking liberation remembered before the heart-thief.
sanskrit_cite: śāntaye na sukhalipsutā manāg bhaktisambhṛtamadeṣu taiḥ prabhoḥ mokṣamārgaṇaphalāpi nārthanā smaryate hṛdayahāriṇaḥ puraḥ

plain_english: Waking or other state, or any beyond, while slightly steady — for the devotee-people, all is Your festival in the ever-present mind.
sanskrit_cite: jāgaretaradaśāthavā parā yāpi kācana manāg avasthiteḥ bhaktibhājanajanasya sākhilā tvatsanāthamanaso mahotsavaḥ

plain_english: Mind's eye-wheel courses, everywhere loosened yet still — reaching You, of firm-long awareness: Lord, how, by devotion-wealth's heat?
sanskrit_cite: āmano 'kṣavalayasya vṛttayaḥ sarvataḥ śithilavṛttayo 'pi tāḥ tvām avāpya dṛḍhadīrghasaṃvido nātha bhaktidhanasoṣmaṇāṃ katham

plain_english: Nothing divided was left uncreated, no non-pleasure unmade here — yet all suffers and divides in every way: bow to the wonder-abode.
sanskrit_cite: na ca vibhinnam asṛjyata kiñcid asty atha sukhetarad atra na nirmitam atha ca duḥkhi ca bhedi ca sarvathāpy asamavismayadhāma namo 'stu te

plain_english: Of me whose thought-stain is washed bright by hard-denier nectar-filling flood, whose unconquered-doubt-foe is crushed — may Your sight be unbroken.
sanskrit_cite: kharaniṣedhakhadāmṛtapūraṇocchalitadhautavikalpamalasya me dalitadurjayasaṃśayavairiṇas tvadavalokanam astu nirantaram

plain_english: Enter me plainly, then may I enter Thee — always, Lord, for I am Thine: with violent speed may I worship Thy body face to face.
sanskrit_cite: sphuṭam aviśa mām athāviśeyaṃ satataṃ nātha bhavantamasmi yasmāt rabhasena vapus tavaiva sākṣāt paramāsattigataḥ samarcayeyam

plain_english: In You no one's is praise-power — yet it exists since You are so beautiful; my constant prayer again is this: that I behold You, Lord, unwearied.
sanskrit_cite: tvayi na stutiśaktir asti kasyāpy athavāsty eva yato 'tisundaro 'si satataṃ punar arthitaṃ mamaitad yad aviśrānti vilokayeyam īśam
